subject: prd/implement-now
statement: The live sibling contract and design explicitly authorize impl-review's host adapter to perform FR-6 for the reviewer program through exactly-one publication returning a native receipt; every supported adapter then preflights and launches the qualified review-role model/effort without worker controls; reviewers run in isolated exact-revision workspaces under separate bounded capacity and return one completed report to that broker; only its exact proposal artifact authenticated to the launched attempt and protected canonical receipt verifies, independent of code-host author; every failure emits EVT-15 with the correct three-way class and EVT-16 carries exact completed/failed/pending/class counts without changing EVT-10.
fit_criterion: sibling-contract capability inspection plus absent/ambiguous-performer, missing-receipt, and missing-exactly-once refusal fixtures; absent/empty/factory/auth admission matrix; four-adapter assurance-band route/launch matrix; isolated-workspace/concurrency trace; exactly-one broker publish/native-receipt trace with no implement-now or child publisher; worker-prewrite/direct-write/receipt-or-state-substitution/store-mutation/replay/same-author/different-author/secret-leak matrix; malformed/stale/paginated/lagged/transport matrix; attended+JSONL wire assertions; task-outcome non-regression, tally, and exit assertions
